Principal Product Manager - Consumer Fintech
Jupiter Money
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About Jupiter:
Jupiter is building the smartest neobanking experience for India's digital generation.

Role:
• Lead credit, lending, and investment product strategy for millions of users.
• Define North Star metrics, roadmap, unit economics, and regulatory compliance.
• Direct multi-functional pods of engineers, designers, and growth analysts.

Requirements:
• 5-8 years of product management experience in consumer tech or fintech.
• Tier-1 engineering or premier MBA (IIT/BITS/IIM) preferred.
• High user empathy, product sense, and data fluency (SQL, Amplitude).
